system.description: While in combat, you can enter a state of frenzy. While in this state, you can't use Intellect points, but you add +1 to your Might Edge and your Speed Edge. This effect lasts as long as you wish, but it ends if no combat is taking place within range of your senses. Effort: Ease your allies' attacks against one foe of your choice for the rest of the combat. Enabler.
